subject: Riverton Logistics — onboarding & payment orientation + PO workflow
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Ruiz <elena.ruiz@rivertonlogistics.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 22 Jul 2025 09:15:00 -0000
Subject: Riverton Logistics — onboarding & payment orientation + PO workflow

Hi Elena,

Thanks again for taking the time yesterday. We're excited to get Riverton set up so our procurement and finance teams can start issuing POs and routing payments on a regular cadence. To keep things moving, please find attached a short buyer intake template — if you can fill that and return within five business days that will let us create the vendor record and schedule the first PO.

Primary items we need from you:
- Legal entity name (as registered with IRS) and DBA if different
- Tax ID / EIN and a signed W-9 (attached is our preferred template)
- Complete remit-to address and billing contact (include name, phone, email)
- Bank details for ACH (account name, routing number, account number) and for wire transfers (bank name, SWIFT/IBAN as applicable)
- Bank confirmation letter or voided check for account verification
- Preferred invoice routing and PO requirements (do you require a PO number on invoice? preferred invoice email or portal?)
- Invoices: sample invoice PDF with required fields (we typically require invoice number, PO number, invoice date, remit-to, itemized charges)

A few notes on our side:
- Redwood issues POs centrally from procurement — our default payment term is Net 30, but exceptions can be discussed with finance.
- Once we receive the intake + W-9 + bank confirmation, finance will validate and provide a vendor ID.
- For ACH, we perform micro-deposit verification for first-time vendors, or we can accept a bank letter signed by the bank on letterhead.

Attachments included: buyer_intake_template.xlsx (please complete), our vendor wiring guidance (PDF) for reference.

If it's helpful, I can schedule a 20-minute call with Markus (finance) and Monica (legal) later this week to answer any questions about documentation or PO terms.

Thanks,
Sean Gallagher
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

--

Subject: Re: Riverton Logistics — onboarding & payment orientation + PO workflow

Hi Sean — thanks for the clear checklist. I filled out the buyer intake form and attached our signed W-9 and an ACH letter from our bank. A couple of quick answers/questions below: 

- Legal entity: Riverton Logistics, Inc. (EIN: 12-3456789) — see attached W-9 (Riverton_W9.pdf).
- Remit-to / billing contact: Accounts Payable — ap@rivertonlogistics.com / +1 (203) 555-4456.
- Invoice routing: Please send invoices to ap@rivertonlogistics.com. We can also receive via our vendor portal (portal.rivertonlogistics.com) but email is faster for initial invoices.
- PO numbers: We require PO numbers on invoice line items for automated matching; will you be issuing a single PO per shipment or per month?
- Payments: ACH is preferred for domestic payments; bank details attached (Riverton_ACH_Letter.pdf) and a scanned voided check can be provided on request. For international wires we use SWIFT: RIVBUS33.
- Payment terms: Net 30 is acceptable. Would Redwood consider early-pay (2/10) if we offer a small discount?

Attachments: Riverton_W9.pdf, Riverton_ACH_Letter.pdf, filled_buyer_intake.xlsx (completed).

Let me know if you need anything else and happy to hop on a quick call.

Best,
Elena Ruiz
Head of Finance Operations
Riverton Logistics
elena.ruiz@rivertonlogistics.com | +1 (203) 555-4456

Date: Wed, 23 Jul 2025 08:30:00 -0000
Subject: Re: Riverton Logistics — onboarding & payment orientation + PO workflow

Hi Elena — welcome, and thanks for the quick turnaround. A few follow-ups from finance before we create the vendor record: 

1) Bank verification: the ACH letter is a great start. Can you also provide either a voided check or an official bank confirmation letter on bank letterhead with an authorized signature (we use that for ACH setup)?.

2) W-9: we received the PDF but the form currently appears unsigned. Can you send a signed W-9 (electronic signature OK) or confirm the signatory name and date?

3) Invoice matching: Redwood will include one PO per shipment by default. Please confirm that your AP team can match invoice line items to PO numbers. If you have a preferred invoice template that maps to PO line items, please attach it.

4) Tax forms / tax residency: For US vendors the W-9 is sufficient. If you have any non-US entities involved (subsidiaries), please let us know.

5) Banking detail validation: for our records, please also include a copy of a bank statement (redacted account balances OK) showing the account number matching the ACH letter — this speeds the verification.

Once we have the above, Monica will complete a brief vendor risk/contract review and finance will issue the vendor ID. I attached our vendor wiring guidance PDF for your reference.

Thanks,
Markus Klein
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
markus.klein@redwood.ai

Our AP can match PO numbers by line item; we typically receive one PO per shipment but can support consolidated monthly invoicing if Redwood prefers.

A couple of practical notes:
- Please provide the Redwood vendor ID and the contact we'll use for PO clarifications.
- For early-pay programs, we're open to a 2/10 discount for a reduced invoice fee — happy to formalize if Redwood's finance team is interested.

I'll upload the voided check and redacted bank statement to the secure folder you shared (Drive link) and ping once done.

Best,
